contract: PATCH /api/api-keys/:id lets an admin change only isActive and userId of an existing key, preserving omitted values and the name/expiry that live in the JWT; a non-root admin cannot update a key owned by root, and unknown keys answer 404.
exceptions: force is not applicable: this route has no force, hard or override mode

invariants.contract: PATCH /api/api-keys/:id with isActive/userId answers 200 with {apiKey:{..., user:{id,username,type}}}, persists the new flag or owner, moves updatedAt forward on a change, keeps omitted name/expiry/isActive values, and the key token authorises as the new owner or is rejected while inactive.
PATCH /api/api-keys/:id with the already stored values answers 200 with the stored key, keeps updatedAt and the persisted row unchanged, and preserves omitted fields.

PATCH /api/api-keys/:id answers 404 for an unknown key, 400 for a non-boolean isActive and a missing/unknown/non-string userId, 403 for a non-admin caller and 403 for a non-root admin updating a root-owned key; rejected requests leave the stored key unchanged.
